bounded_interpretation: This isolates deterministic ranking/fusion consequences within Case 0016's sealed frame and fixed treatments, conditional on the sole blind primary gold. It establishes no production benefit, universal retrieval superiority, agent success or search-policy failure. B uses A-derived seeds, so agreement is not independent evidence. Direct self/cross shares are post-gold diagnostics; no counterfactual edge removal or prospective treatment rerun occurred.

A.scope: Selected complete mandatory witness prefixes only; incomplete obligations have no invented prefix

B.scope: Selected complete mandatory witness prefixes only; incomplete obligations have no invented prefix

C.scope: Selected complete mandatory witness prefixes only; incomplete obligations have no invented prefix

cost_comparison.interpretation: Single captured run. Shared preparation, RI, B propagation, C fusion, diagnostic work and journal durability have separate scopes; never double-count runtime and durability. No production-performance claim or cost gate.

costs.interpretation: Single run, descriptive only; no effectiveness/cost gate or production extrapolation. Operation runtime and durability are separate, never added twice.

dimension_policy: Movement dimensions are WORSENED if any regression exists; gains are reported separately. Graph-novel evidence is a diagnostic of added obligation-relative labels. Cost compares captured additional Graph-3 operations, with no scientific cost gate.

failure_summary.diagnosis_evidence: Per REQUIRED regression retain newly overtaking resources, their owning labels, A/B/C ranks, graph RRF contributions and native incoming References. GRAPH_PROPAGATION_NOISE requires a demonstrated UNNECESSARY graph-supported overtaker. Disconnected REQUIRED evidence has no incoming edge; other A-only REQUIRED evidence is LEXICAL_ONLY_REQUIRED_EVIDENCE.

historical_comparison.interpretation: Graph-3 concentrates a compact ranked forward Reference view without path expansion, but finds no necessary graph-novel evidence here. Graph-1/2 retained large expansion/reversal/fanout surfaces and sampled 2/128 and 0/128 useful outcomes. Their unsampled populations remain unjudged; USEFUL is not identical to this gold's REQUIRED/HELPFUL labels. Tasks/populations differ; no controlled causal superiority claim across Graph-1/2 versus Graph-3. Reverse-dependency noise is not assigned to this forward-only Graph-3.
historical_comparison.provenance: Authenticated amended Stage A historical_development seals; retained Increment 32/33 development results, freeze and README only

next_step: Maintainer reviews the completed Graph-3 Stage D verdict and causal diagnostics.
precedence: REQUIRED resource/cell/unit reach loss OR baseline completion loss OR any unbounded required rank/selected depth regression => GRAPH_HARMFUL
Valid and no loss/unbounded regression, graph-contributed meaningful witness gain or REQUIRED reach rescue AND (strong burden improvement OR safe material reach gain) => GRAPH_HYBRID_SUPPORTED
No loss/unbounded regression, graph-contributed meaningful rank/witness gain or novel REQUIRED reach rescue => COMPLEMENTARY_GRAPH_VALUE

primary_answers.DID GRAPH-ONLY B FIND NECESSARY EVIDENCE: NO. Every B-only resource is UNNECESSARY under its owning obligation. A already reaches all 36 REQUIRED cells and all 48 required units.
primary_answers.DID HYBRID C ACTUALLY PRESERVE/USE IT?: There is no graph-novel necessary evidence to preserve or rescue. C preserves A's complete reach, uses B to improve five meaningful REQUIRED ranks and O2 completion, and also worsens 30 REQUIRED ranks.
primary_answers.DID RRF DILUTE OR AMPLIFY USEFUL GRAPH E: Mixed rank movement: C amplifies B's useful resource.py rank 11 to C rank 6 and planned_reference.py rank 14 to C rank 9; materialization.py B/C ranks are 3/2 (O2), 3/1 (O3), 7/8 (O4). Across necessary evidence C adds substantial regression and prefix burden. No new necessary reach appears; RRF cannot satisfy the frozen safety bounds.
primary_answers.DID TASK-CONDITIONED PROPAGATED REFERENC: NO under the frozen primary rule: GRAPH_HARMFUL. Some required ranks and O2 improve, but unbounded REQUIRED-rank and selected-witness-depth regressions take precedence; reach is unchanged and burden increases.
primary_answers.WERE MATERIAL GAINS DRIVEN BY CROSS-RESO: Both kinds of direct incoming flow occur. O2 resource.py and O5 planned_reference.py gains have 100% cross-resource incoming flow from tests/context/planning/test_plan.py. The three meaningful materialization.py gains are majority self-flow (85.5232%, 72.6508%, 53.8878% for O2/O3/O4), with captured cross-resource support. Shares partition the captured treatment; no self-edge ablation or new causal threshold is applied.

publication_costs.note: Measured once. Excludes final integrity publication and subsequent read-only verification.
